item.title: F*ck You, Pay Me!
item.description:
Sauce: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/05/trump-administration-has-paid-back-100bn-of-165bn-tariff-refunds Canada is getting about 10% of the pot. Meanwhile, y'all get to deal with this: Remember, due to tarrifs companies like Amazon added "surcharge" to all of your purchases and billing. So did Walmart & Apple... Guess what?
Yes, $166bn for domestic refunds, all going to corps! They never paid any tarrif cost because they passed the cost unto you. You get zilch! So, MAGA/MAHA/whatever the fuck you fucks call yourselves...
Seems Mars got me this time. 35 dv in 2 mins lol
